(2) pipeline.EnsureEnvDirs(root) creates buffer/in_progress/done/bash/notifications/target/scripts at cmd_process startup — scripts assume these exist (without them `mv BUFFER→IN_PROGRESS` silently renames into a FILE). (3) Two runtime bugs found and fixed by new end-to-end test TestBuildAndExecute_RealInputs (app/script/build_e2e_test.go): audio -map lines' trailing `\` glued the next shell command (cp) into the ffmpeg argv ('Unable to find a suitable output format for cp') — output block consolidated into buildOutputFiles with continuation only on non-final lines; -profile is ambiguous in ffmpeg 5.x → -profile:v. (4) E2E test executes the rendered script with bash+ffmpeg against the synthetic fixture: asserts target video/m4a×2/ready marker, notifications copy, done/ movements incl. script self-archive to done/bash, drained buffer/in_progress. Live-testing ops flow: pipeline scans --in (unit dirs); a feeder places unit files into <out>/buffer (flat); scripts consume from buffer.
